scope: Constant Emission surfaces and scene-linear photograph sampling

constantEmission.defect: An unlinked Emission surface skipped shader-graph export and inherited reflected diffuse/specular light from the reduced physical material.
constantEmission.fix: Always retain the Emission graph, including black constant Emission.
constantEmission.verification: Nine Python export/ownership tests passed; native and public-editor roof-input captures use black Emission for every other surface. The browser surfaces now remain black.

linearCapture.defect: Render Result/EXR capture used one raster sample per output pixel while PNG capture already resolved four scene-linear samples.
linearCapture.fix: Both paths render twice the requested width and height, then resolve scene-linear radiance before readback or display conversion.
linearCapture.verification: Nine capture/display tests, engine and Three typechecks, staged product build, and actual WebGL control passed. The existing editor window stayed open.

courtyard.comparison: Same-camera native Cycles and public-editor emission controls; roof mask eroded two pixels. This is an input comparison, not a shaded-material acceptance gate.
courtyard.remaining: Significant normal response and indirect-light differences remain. Full courtyard parity has not passed.
